description.ja: 『魔神英雄伝ワタル』より、プラモデルオリジナル解釈の高頭身アレンジを施した「龍神丸」がHG Amplified IMGNで立体化！
description.en: From "Mashin Hero Wataru ", " Ryujinmaru" with a tall head and body arrangement based on the original interpretation of the plastic model is now three-dimensional with HG Amplified IMGN!

description.ja: • 高頭身ならではの長い手足を活かした徒手空拳アクションが新たな魅力を増幅。
description.en: • The empty-handed air fist action that takes advantage of the long limbs unique to his tall head and body amplifies his new appeal.

description.ja: • グロスインジェクション成形とゴールドメッキパーツを採用。パーツ構成による高密度な造形が艶やかな質感と豪華さを表現。
description.en: • Adopts gloss injection molding and gold plated parts. The high-density modeling of the parts configuration expresses a glossy texture and luxury.

description.ja: • 白・赤部の成形箇所は、立体感を強調するグロスインジェクションで構成。
description.en: • The white and red molding areas are made of gloss injection that emphasizes the three-dimensional effect.

description.ja: • 機体各所のゴールドメッキはマットな仕上がりで高級感を演出。
description.en: • The gold plating on various parts of the aircraft has a matte finish, giving it a luxurious feel.

description.ja: • 巨大な刀身にゴールドメッキを施した「登龍剣」と各種ハンドパーツが付属。「登龍剣」は背面に取り付け可能。
description.en: • "Toryuken " with a huge gold-plated blade and various hand parts are included. " Toryuken" can be attached to the back.

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ 武器持ち手(左右)、組み替え用平手パーツ(左右)
accessories.en: Hand parts Weapon handles (left and right), open hand parts for rearrangement (left and right)
